name: Sweetgrass Market
what_it_does: A direct marketplace for Lowcountry sweetgrass basket makers. Makers list pieces with photos and provenance, buyers browse by form and size, and order requests go straight to the maker by text so nothing sits behind a platform account.
target_user: Sweetgrass basket makers along Highway 17 in Mount Pleasant and buyers who want to purchase directly from them.
strengths: Highest feels_distinctive in the pool at 0.90. Reviewers recognized the makers and the baskets.
Understood immediately by 86 percent of reviewers.
Order requests reach the maker by text, which matches how the makers already sell.

agent_observations.note: Human review is strong across every metric. The gaps are all in automated checks: security_headers failed and the console logs 2 errors on the listing page. No product in the current pool carries a security or stability tag. Do not force a match. Report the gap and wait for the pool to grow.
